title: Theorem 7.2.4: compactness of minimizing currents
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open and T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U (Simon 7.1.1), with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U (∂-mass read as 0 when n = 0), and T_j ⇀ T in 𝒟_n(U). Then T is integer multiplicity and minimizing in U, and μ_{T_j} → μ_T as Radon measures in U: for all integer multiplicity representations of the T_j and of T, ∫ f dμ_{T_j} → ∫ f dμ_T for every continuous f with compact support in U.
